dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Ah, when I think that this journey in Inazuma must end and that we shall not read each other poems again like this, I cannot help but feel a little sad.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: Though they say that "all feasts must someday end," it is inevitable that we shall feel sadness. Lenne, shall we correspond via letters in the future?
